bounding: Every company whose registered postcode district is one of: EC1V, WC2H, from the complete Companies House register snapshot of 2026-08-01 (all 7 parts). Complete within that boundary; no filter on size, age or notability. 1 address(es) whose line names a person rather than a place are withheld entirely, because a claim keyed on such a line is a claim about a private individual; the filter deliberately over-excludes, so some organisations without a legal-form suffix are withheld too.
